semiconductor_relevance: High — Pitotech specializes in system simulation and multiphysics simulation for the semiconductor industry, aiding in R&D and manufacturing processes.
summary: Pitotech Co., LTD is a leading technical consulting company in Taiwan that focuses on system and multiphysics simulation applications within the semiconductor sector. With over 30 years of experience, they help clients optimize R&D cycles and manufacturing processes, enhancing product reliability and yield.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Headquartered in Taichung City, Pitotech is a key player in Taiwan's semiconductor industry.
